body:

title: Appeal an infraction

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey shadow!

We only accept appeals for hacking after 
6-8 months , please appeal after that time and make sure you do not ban evade between now and then.

We appreciate your apology but you must face the consequences of your  actions 

Appeal Denied 

I will lock either once requested or after 24 hours
